text:
From far away I must love you,

from the quiet distance

where love is nostalgia

and desire is constancy.

From the divine place where

the good of existence

is to be eternity

and to seem absence.

Who needs to explain the moment

and the fragrance of the rose

that persuades without any arrogance?

And at the bottom of the sea the star,

without violence,

fulfills its truth

apart from transparency.

translation.title: From Far Away I Must Love You
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Meireles's distant love as constancy, eternity, and almost absent truth.
